headline: Airlangga and OECD Secretary-General's Response on Threat of MSCI Downgrade
summary: Coordinating Minister Airlangga Hartarto said a potential MSCI downgrade of Indonesia's stock market status is not linked to the country's OECD membership. The OECD secretary-general also responded to the threat.
why: MSCI is a major global index provider, and a change in market classification can trigger passive fund flows into or out of a country's equities. Indonesia's stock market is the country's main capital market.
why_moved: A threatened downgrade in MSCI's market classification could prompt index-tracking funds to reduce holdings in Indonesian stocks.
original_headline: Respons Airlangga dan Sekjen OECD Soal Ancaman Downgrade MSCI
